pairs.l: 1 — Staff please remain at desks until midday during the IT monitoring check.
2 — Give all material a very intensive examination — a mistake now will define us.
3 — These two spiders are similar; caution is required in handling them.
4 — Someone has to look after grandma this weekend. She mustn't leave the house!
5 — This examination is very important. Make sure your preparation is thorough.

r1.exp: Poruka 1 (ostanite za stolovima do podne) = C (Stay there). Poruka 2 (pažljivo pregledajte sve materijale) = F (Look closely). Poruka 3 (oprez pri rukovanju sličnim paucima) = E (Watch out). Poruka 4 (ne zaboraviti brinuti o baki) = A (Don't forget). Poruka 5 (ispitivanje je važno, dobro se pripremi) = B (Get ready).

r6.exp: 'Two days to clean grandma's BEACH HOUSE' = vikend uz more = B (At the seaside).

r7.exp: 'I just had a BLAST' = zabavio sam se odlično = A (It's entertaining). Kompleksna je, ali zabavna.

r8.exp: 'The TUBE station is the closest to my house, so I'll go for that' → podzemna željeznica = C (By train / tube).

r9.exp: 'My temperature has shot up' = porasla joj je temperatura → bolest = B (She isn't feeling well).

r10.exp: 'Didn't like wearing anything around her WRISTS' (narukvice) → kupuju ogrlicu = A (A necklace).

r11.exp: Bip je Marceauov scenski alter ego, mimičar (mime character) = C. Pip je lik iz romana, ali Bip je Marceauov scenski lik.

r12.exp: 'Marceau was RECRUITED by his cousin' → pridružio se Otporu zahvaljujući bratiću = B.

r13.exp: 'Evacuate children... get them to the Swiss border, where they would FIND SAFETY' = odvesti djecu na sigurno = A.

r14.exp: 'He PRETENDED that he was a member of the French Army and convinced all 30 to SURRENDER' → pretvario se da je francuski vojnik = A.

r15.exp: 'Thanks to the UNIVERSALITY of his expression... knows neither borders nor nationalities' → razumljivo svima = C.

r16.exp: 'Daily life more digital, (16)____ – comfortable with changing technologies from early age.' → E: which makes them true digital natives. Digitalni urođenici.

r17.exp: 'Thanks to global connectivity, (17)____. Numerous cultures, ideas, and perspectives have shaped them.' → F: they are the product of a universal upbringing. Globalni odgoj.

r18.exp: 'Combined with online platforms, (18)____.' → A: which allows for a personalised academic experience. Online platforme omogućuju personalizirano učenje.

r19.exp: 'First generation in 21st century, (19)____. Climate change, ethical dilemmas...' → D: they will likely face serious challenges.

r20.exp: 'Potential to break barriers and introduce new norms, (20)____.' → B: as they find themselves at the beginning of a new era. Na početku novog doba.

r21.exp: 'One of THE three most famous authors' — određeni član 'the' uz superlativne/ograničene skupove.

r22.exp: 'Depending ON where in the world you were born' — fiksna prijedložna kolokacija: depend on.

r23.exp: 'A recent study, HOWEVER, has found...' — diskurzivni prilog 'however' između zareza koji uvodi neočekivano otkriće.

r24.exp: 'BETWEEN 4,000 and 5,000 years old' — 'between... and...' za raspon između dva broja.

r25.exp: '6,000 years AGO' — prilog 'ago' za vremenski period u prošlosti od sadašnjosti.

r26.exp: 'AT the age of 29 she fled' — prijedlog 'at' uz dob: at the age of.

r27.exp: 'Along WHAT was known as the Underground Railroad' — relativna zamjenica 'what' (= that which) u prepozicijskoj frazi.

r28.exp: 'People who WOULD give shelter escaping slaves' — 'would' za tipičnu prošlu radnju/naviku: would = used to.

r29.exp: 'Settled people IN Canada' — prijedlog 'in' uz ime zemlje gdje su se nastanili.

r30.exp: 'Lived on her farm, WHICH was a refuge' — relativna zamjenica 'which' za ne-restriktivnu surečenicu (uz zarez, odnosi se na farmu).

sol.rubric: Odgovori na sva 3 pitanja: (1) dojmovi nakon prvog semestra, (2) koji dio tečaja ti se najviše svidio i zašto, (3) koje metode učenja preporučuješ i zašto. Dužina 80–100 riječi. Neformalan registar.

w1.exp: Pisani zadatak — nema jednog točnog odgovora. Ocjenjuju se sadržaj (odgovori na sva pitanja), jezik i dužina (80–100 riječi).
